content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Secretary-General position at the United Nations. Tell about your experience in global diplomacy, peace mediation, and promoting sustainable development goals. Describe your vision for reforming the UN and its role in resolving contemporary conflicts. Also reflect on how you would strengthen multilateral cooperation and respond to global challenges. Length about 450 words.
